title: Robust Decentralized Optimization under Node Failures via Adaptive Regularization
summary: We study decentralized minimization of a sum of functions over a network where nodes may only leave, the remaining nodes stay connected, and the topology freezes between departures. Standard methods forget departed functions, causing a permanent bias proportional to the heterogeneity of the data. We propose Legacy Gradient Tracking (Legacy-GT): before leaving, a node compresses its function into a gradient-anchored quadratic legacy, bequeaths it to a neighbor, and provides a correction that exactly preserves the gradient-tracking invariant.
